Sam (AE): Hey team — customer (GlobalBank) just returned the security questionnaire and they're leaning heavily to on-prem, air-gapped POC. Main asks: USB/airgap transport, no egress telemetry, and monthly critical patch windows. Pricing wants an estimate for 6-month pilot.
Elaine (Solutions): Got it. Quick clarifying Qs: do they require immutable signed bundles only, or can we offer delta updates over a trusted jumpbox?
Sam (AE): PM says immutable signed bundles preferred but ops could allow a jumpbox for deltas if we can guarantee chain-of-custody & offline signing. They want upgrade cadence options: monthly security patches vs quarterly feature rollouts.
Matt (Infra Eng): Re: transport — we support three patterns: 1) full signed ISO / installer (sneakernet), 2) chunked delta bundles (USB or jumpbox sync), 3) airgap jumpbox that we push to via VPN during maintenance window. Each has different SHA256 + signature verification steps.
Jia (Security): Important: telemetry must be opt-in and default-off. For air-gapped POC we need a documented telemetry-off build and a signed SBOM. Also KMS: they require HSM-backed key-unsealing, no cloud KMS. Can we support HSM PKCS#11 flow?
Matt (Infra Eng): Yes, we have a PKCS#11 shim in private deployments. Ops note: the signed bundle format looks like:
```
manifest:
  version: 1
  components:
    - name: rwd-inference
      sha256: abcdef...1234
      signature: MEUCIQ...
```
Bundles must be signed with our release key; downstream site can re-sign with their HSM if they want to double-sign.
Elaine (Solutions): For upgrade cadence: monthly patches = higher operational load and a +15% pilot uplift (engineering + signed bundle support + faster QA). Quarterly = standard pilot price. Which price bucket should I give procurement?
Sam (AE): They asked for a conservative quote. Put both: pilot-core (quarterly) and pilot-accelerated (monthly, +15%). Also include an option for on-site engineering support for cutover day (flat day rate).
Jia (Security): Also need to answer their SQ Q17 about logging: we must provide local log retention only (no outbound by default). Include config snippet to disable remote telemetry.
Matt (Infra Eng): Example config to disable egress: 
```yaml
telemetry:
  enabled: false
  upload_endpoint: ""
```
Elaine (Solutions): Operational constraints to call out in SOW: max bundle size for USB = 16GB (we recommend chunked bundles if >16GB), recommended kernel/os compatibility matrix (we only officially support RHEL 8.6 / Ubuntu 22.04), and offline cert rotation cadence (we recommend 90 days).
Sam (AE): Legal flagged CA rotation — they want certificate rotation without inbound connectivity. Is that doable?
Jia (Security): Yes, provide a rotation CLI that ingests a signed cert file. Must be done with offline signing and recorded in audit logs. We need to include instructions in runbook.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: #PILOT-4123 — onprem bundle + SQ answers. Owner: Elaine.
Elaine (Solutions): Action items: I'll draft the SOW with two pricing tiers, the runbook appendix for bundle signing & rotation, and the SQ answers. Matt — can you validate the chunking tool and confirm max bundle size limitations? Jia — you ok to draft the SQ answers for Q17 and Q21 (KMS/HSM)?
Matt (Infra Eng): On it. Quick note: we discovered a kernel module mismatch on older RHEL kernels that blocks GPU drivers; will include a compatibility matrix and a preflight script that checks driver versions.
Jia (Security): I'll draft the SQ text. For KMS/HSM we should include: PKCS#11 support, role-based access for key import, and offline sealing procedure.
Sam (AE): Customer asks about rollback path if a bundle fails. Short answer?
Matt (Infra Eng): We ship a rollback manifest in every bundle. If apply fails, the agent will auto-revert to previous manifest within the same maintenance window. Must be in SOW that they keep old bundle available for 7 days.
Elaine (Solutions): Pricing note: accelerated monthly patching requires a signed delta workflow + weekly build validation — that's why +15%. Also recommend optional 2-day on-site support for initial cutover.
Sam (AE): Perfect. I'll share both proposals. Tentative timeline: SOW draft by EOD Wed, security answers by Thu, pilot kickoff week after next.
Jia (Security): :thumbsup: I'll attach the SQ snippets in the ticket.
Matt (Infra Eng): I'll attach the preflight script and chunker docs.
Elaine (Solutions): Thanks — I'll ping legal for the CA rotation language and update the pricing sheet.
Sam (AE): Great — closing the loop. If any blocker appears update #PILOT-4123.
